newsitem.title: USA: Hewlett-Packard shrs punished, techs weaken.
newsitem.headline: Hewlett-Packard shrs punished, techs weaken.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co's disappointing second quarter earnings scattered investors Friday, knocking 10 percent off H-P's share price amid a broader abandonment of technology issues.
"Hewlett-Packard reported second quarter results in which revenues, orders and earnings were all below (Wall) Street expectations," Lehman Brothers analyst George Elling said in a research note.
In midmorning New York Stock Exchange trade, Hewlett-Packard was off 6-1/8 to 52-3/4 and was the market's most active issue with over four million shares traded.
